description: Config form spec for one temperature Sensor entry in devicecfg.json Sensors[]. Flattened Properties; native DTDL writable + Enum coverage; the rest is in config-rules.js. Temperature supports v1.0 (MetricName is the hardware source name itself, e.g. 'cpU-therm') and v1.1 (MetricName='therm' + Parameters.Source / Parameters.Sources).
comment: MetricName is a free-form non-empty string (DTDL Enum can't model v1.0). v1.1 recommends 'therm'. Source / Sources are mutually exclusive; both are only valid when MetricName='therm'; v1.0 (MetricName != 'therm') must NOT carry Source / Sources. All cross-field rules enforced by config-rules.js (rules.temperature). Every temperature MetricName -> wire schema 'double'.

schemas.description: SensorGroup allow-list for temperature sensors. Conventionally 'TEMP'.
Wire schema allow-list. Every temperature MetricName -> 'double'.
Array<string> schema referenced by the Sources Property. DTDL v2 requires complex schemas (Array / Object / Map) used by Properties to be declared in schemas[] rather than inline.

contents.name: Name
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty ASCII string, 1..128 chars, unique within Sensors[]. Uniqueness enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Name
UI hint: text input on create; read-only after.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: SensorGroup
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from the SensorGroup enum (temperature sensors use 'TEMP').
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorGroup
UI hint: dropdown, default 'TEMP'.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: MetricType
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'temperature' for this Interface.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricType
UI hint: fixed label, not editable.
Writable: immutable -- changing it requires defining a new Sensor.

contents.name: MetricName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string. v1.1 recommended value is 'therm' (then put the source name in Source / Sources). v1.0-compatible: any hardware source name (e.g. 'cpU-therm'). MetricName != 'therm' MUST NOT carry Source / Sources (config-rules.js rules.temperature).
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricName
UI hint: dropdown with 'therm' default + free-text override for v1.0 fallback.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Source
contents.description:
OPTIONAL (temperature-specific, v1.1 mode, MetricName='therm' only).
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string naming a single onboard thermal source. Mutex with Sources (config-rules.js rules.temperature). MUST NOT appear when MetricName != 'therm'.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.Source
UI hint: text input. Hide unless MetricName='therm' AND Sources is empty.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Sources
contents.description:
OPTIONAL (temperature-specific, v1.1 mode, MetricName='therm' only).
VALIDATION RULE: array of non-empty strings. Empty array means auto-detect across every onboard source. Mutex with Source (config-rules.js rules.temperature). MUST NOT appear when MetricName != 'therm'.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.Sources
UI hint: chip / tag input. Hide unless MetricName='therm' AND Source is empty. Empty = auto-detect.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Enabled
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: boolean.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Enabled
UI hint: toggle / switch.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able (SIL2 maintenance lever).

contents.name: Interval
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: integer, 1 <= v <= 300000 (5 minutes). Range enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Interval
UI hint: number input, min=1, max=300000, step=100, default=1000.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Description
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Description
UI hint: textarea or text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: DisplayName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.DisplayName
UI hint: short text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Schema
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'double' for every temperature MetricName. Enforced by config-rules.js; the agent rejects startup on mismatch.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Schema
UI hint: dropdown, default 'double'.
Writable: immutable after creation.
